name: AT&T
summary: One of the three national networks. Plans are postpaid and billed monthly.
autopayTerms: AT&T takes $10 off each line every month with AutoPay and paperless billing from a bank account or the AT&T Points Plus Card. A debit card gets $5 off per line. Any other credit card gets no discount. The discount starts within 2 bills.

fees.oneTimeNote: Activation fee of up to $50 per line, per AT&T's plan page. We count the full $50.
